run_train_dreambooth_flax: run the dreambooth training script for Flax Stable Diffusion with instance images and prompts
create_DreamBoothDataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads and preprocesses instance and class images with tokenized prompts
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse command-line arguments for dreambooth training configuration
run_train_step: run the train_step function that computes loss and applies gradients for unet and text encoder
run_checkpoint: run the checkpoint function to save trained pipeline parameters and optionally push to hub
